name: careerbridge-platform
description: CareerBridge - Personalized Multi-Disciplinary Career Navigation & Adaptive Learning Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm install --prefix server --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server

author: CareerBridge Team
